`gs_vs/datasets/` is the COLMAP parser of gsplat v1.5.3 (`examples/datasets/colmap.py`, `normalize.py`,
`examples/exif.py`; https://github.com/nerfstudio-project/gsplat, Apache License 2.0, see `gs_vs/LICENSE`), with a
relative import of `exif`. It reads the training cameras with the same world normalisation as gsplat training.
